scholarships.name: PM-USP Central Sector Scheme of Scholarships for College and University Students (CSSS)
scholarships.provider: Ministry of Education, Government of India (via NSP)
scholarships.amount: ₹12,000/year for first 3 years (UG); ₹20,000/year for 4th & 5th years (Technical/PG)
scholarships.description: Flagship merit-cum-means central government scheme on the National Scholarship Portal (NSP) supporting meritorious regular college and engineering students from low-to-middle income families.
scholarships.eligibility_notes: Requires scoring above the 80th percentile in Class 12 board exams in the respective stream (80% used as an indicative screening rule; exact board percentile cutoffs apply). Student must be in a regular full-time course without a drop year and not receiving other scholarships.
application_steps: Complete One-Time Registration (OTR) on the National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in).
Select PM-USP Central Sector Scheme (Department of Higher Education) under Fresh Application.
Enter Class 12 roll number, academic details, annual family income, and institution details.
Upload scanned income certificate and required academic proof.
Submit online and get the application verified by your Institute Nodal Officer (INO).

scholarships.name: AICTE Pragati Scholarship Scheme for Girl Students (Technical Degree)
scholarships.provider: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)
scholarships.amount: ₹50,000 per annum (for up to 4 years of degree study)
required_documents: Parent Declaration (up to 2 girl children per family)
scholarships.description: AICTE scheme empowering girl students admitted to the 1st year (or 2nd year lateral entry) of AICTE-approved technical degree courses like B.Tech/B.E.
scholarships.eligibility_notes: Restricted to girl students (up to 2 girl children per family) admitted to 1st year or 2nd year lateral entry in an AICTE-approved degree institution.
application_steps: Register on the National Scholarship Portal (NSP) via OTR.
Choose 'AICTE - Pragati Scholarship Scheme for Girl Students (Technical Degree)'.
Fill admission details, AICTE institution ID, and family income below ₹8,00,000.
Upload income certificate, admission proof, and parental declaration.
Submit before closing date and complete institute-level verification.

scholarships.name: AICTE Saksham Scholarship Scheme for Specially Abled Students (Technical Degree)
scholarships.provider: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)
scholarships.amount: ₹50,000 per annum (for up to 4 years of degree study)
required_documents: UDID / Disability Certificate (40% or more disability)
scholarships.description: Dedicated AICTE technical education scholarship providing financial encouragement to specially-abled students with >=40% disability pursuing B.Tech/B.E.
scholarships.eligibility_notes: Applicant must have a valid disability certificate showing not less than 40% disability and be admitted in 1st year (or 2nd year lateral entry) of an AICTE-approved technical degree.
application_steps: Complete OTR registration on scholarships.gov.in.
Select 'AICTE - Saksham Scholarship Scheme for Specially Abled Students (Technical Degree)'.
Upload UDID/Disability Certificate (>=40%), income proof, and admission letter.
Ensure Institute Nodal Officer verifies the application on NSP.

scholarships.name: AICTE Swanath Scholarship Scheme (Technical Degree)
scholarships.provider: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)
scholarships.amount: ₹50,000 per annum
required_documents: Death Certificate(s) / Armed Forces Martyr Certificate (as applicable)
scholarships.description: AICTE support scheme for orphans, wards of parents who passed due to COVID-19, or wards of Armed Forces/Central Paramilitary personnel martyred in action.
scholarships.eligibility_notes: Applicable only to eligible special-circumstance categories (orphan, COVID-affected parent loss, or Armed Forces/CAPF martyr ward) in AICTE-approved institutions.
application_steps: Register on NSP (scholarships.gov.in) under AICTE schemes.
Attach supporting special-category certificates and income certificate.
Verify through the institution nodal desk.

scholarships.name: Post-Matric Scholarship for Scheduled Caste (SC) Students (NSP / Central)
scholarships.provider: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment (via NSP / State Portals)
scholarships.amount: Compulsory non-refundable tuition fee reimbursement + academic allowance (varies by course group)
scholarships.description: Centrally sponsored post-matric financial support covering compulsory tuition fees and maintenance allowance for SC students across higher secondary, UG, B.Tech, and PG programs.
scholarships.eligibility_notes: Applicable strictly to SC category students with annual family income up to ₹2,50,000; routed through NSP or state DBT portals depending on the student's domicile state.
application_steps: Check whether your domicile state routes SC Post-Matric via NSP or the State Scholarship Portal.
Complete registration with caste, income, and bank DBT details.
Upload fee receipt, marksheet, caste and income certificates.
Submit for institute and district welfare officer verification.

scholarships.name: Post-Matric Scholarship for Scheduled Tribe (ST) Students (NSP / Central)
scholarships.provider: Ministry of Tribal Affairs (via NSP / State Portals)
scholarships.amount: Tuition and compulsory fee coverage + monthly maintenance allowance
scholarships.description: Central assistance for ST students pursuing post-matriculation studies including professional degrees like B.Tech/Engineering.
scholarships.eligibility_notes: Restricted to ST category students with annual family income not exceeding ₹2,50,000.
application_steps: Apply on NSP or your state tribal welfare portal as notified by your state.
Upload valid ST caste certificate, income certificate, and fee receipt.
Complete college verification before the state deadline.

scholarships.name: Merit-cum-Means Scholarship for Professional and Technical Courses CS (Minorities)
scholarships.provider: Ministry of Minority Affairs (via NSP)
scholarships.amount: Course fee reimbursement (up to ₹20,000/yr) + maintenance allowance (₹5,000–₹10,000/yr)
scholarships.description: Supports notified minority community students (Muslim, Christian, Sikh, Buddhist, Jain, Parsi) enrolled in technical and professional degrees such as B.Tech.
scholarships.eligibility_notes: Requires >=50% marks in previous final examination and family income <= ₹2,50,000; check active NSP cycle availability.
application_steps: Create OTR ID on scholarships.gov.in.
Select Ministry of Minority Affairs -> Merit-cum-Means Scholarship for Professional and Technical Courses.
Upload minority declaration, income certificate, marksheet, and fee receipt.
Verify through college nodal officer.

scholarships.name: PM-YASASVI Post-Matric Scholarship for OBC, EBC and DNT Students
scholarships.provider: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment (via NSP / States)
scholarships.amount: Academic allowance + tuition support (varies by course group & state)
scholarships.description: Umbrella central scheme supporting OBC, Economically Backward Class (EBC), and DNT students in post-matriculation and engineering programs.
scholarships.eligibility_notes: Verify state implementation guidelines on NSP or state OBC welfare portals; exact allowance depends on course group and hosteller/day-scholar status.
application_steps: Verify state-specific portal routing (NSP vs State portal).
Submit OBC/EBC certificate, income certificate (<=₹2.5 Lakh), and college admission documents.

scholarships.name: Prime Minister's Scholarship Scheme (PMSS) for CAPFs & Assam Rifles
scholarships.provider: Welfare & Rehabilitation Board, Ministry of Home Affairs (via NSP)
scholarships.amount: ₹30,000/year (Boys) and ₹36,000/year (Girls)
required_documents: Service Certificate / Dependent ID of CAPF/Assam Rifles Personnel
scholarships.description: Merit scholarship for dependent wards and widows of Central Armed Police Forces & Assam Rifles personnel pursuing first professional degrees like B.Tech.
scholarships.eligibility_notes: Strictly for dependent wards/widows of CAPF, Assam Rifles, or State Police personnel (in terror/naxal action categories) with >=60% in MEQ.
application_steps: Apply on NSP under Ministry of Home Affairs -> PMSS.
Upload Service Certificate signed by Head of Office and academic marksheets.

scholarships.name: Central Sector Scholarship of Top Class Education for SC/ST Students
scholarships.provider: Ministry of Social Justice / Ministry of Tribal Affairs (via NSP)
scholarships.amount: Full tuition fee (up to notified ceiling) + living expenses, books & computer allowance
required_documents: Admission Proof in Notified Premier Institution (IIT/NIT/IIIT/etc.)
scholarships.description: Supports meritorious SC and ST students admitted to notified institutions of excellence (such as IITs, NITs, IIITs, IIMs, and top colleges).
scholarships.eligibility_notes: Requires admission to an institution notified under the Central Top Class list; verify exact income ceiling (₹6–8 Lakh depending on ministry) on NSP.
application_steps: Confirm your institute is on the NSP Top Class notified institutions list.
Apply on scholarships.gov.in with caste, income, and admission proof.

scholarships.name: MahaDBT Rajarshi Chhatrapati Shahu Maharaj Shikshan Shulkh Shishyavritti (EBC)
scholarships.provider: Directorate of Technical Education, Government of Maharashtra
scholarships.amount: Up to 50% tuition fee and exam fee waiver (or up to 100% for specific income slabs)
scholarships.description: Maharashtra state tuition fee reimbursement scheme for Economically Backward Class (EBC) students admitted through CAP rounds in professional courses like B.Tech.
scholarships.eligibility_notes: Maharashtra domicile and admission via Centralized Admission Process (CAP) required; confirm exact current-year DTE rules on MahaDBT.
application_steps: Create profile on mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in.
Select Directorate of Technical Education -> Rajarshi Chhatrapati Shahu Maharaj Scheme.
Upload CAP allotment letter, domicile, and income certificate.

scholarships.name: UP Post-Matric Scholarship & Fee Reimbursement Scheme
scholarships.provider: Social Welfare Department, Government of Uttar Pradesh
scholarships.amount: Tuition fee reimbursement + scholarship allowance (subject to UP state budget norms)
scholarships.description: Uttar Pradesh state scholarship and fee reimbursement program supporting UP-domiciled students enrolled in diploma, B.Tech, and higher education courses.
scholarships.eligibility_notes: Income ceiling is typically ₹2,00,000 for General/OBC/Minority and ₹2,50,000 for SC/ST categories; verify exact category ceiling on scholarship.up.gov.in.
application_steps: Register on scholarship.up.gov.in under Post-Matric (Other than Inter) Fresh/Renewal.
Authenticate income and caste certificate numbers online.
Submit printed hardcopy with documents to your college scholarship cell.

scholarships.name: Swami Vivekananda Merit-cum-Means Scholarship (SVMCM - Bikash Bhavan)
scholarships.provider: Higher Education Department, Government of West Bengal
scholarships.amount: ₹60,000/year for Engineering UG (varies from ₹12,000–₹60,000/yr by stream)
scholarships.description: West Bengal's flagship merit-cum-means scholarship offering substantial annual grants for engineering, medical, and general degree students.
scholarships.eligibility_notes: West Bengal domicile and enrollment in a West Bengal recognized institute required; >=60% in Class 12 for UG/Engineering.
application_steps: Register on svmcm.wbhed.gov.in.
Upload Class 12 marksheet, income certificate (BDO/SDO/Gazetted format), and admission proof.
Track forwarding by Institution Head and Directorate verification.

scholarships.name: Karnataka State Scholarship Portal (SSP) Post-Matric & Vidyasiri Scheme
scholarships.provider: Department of Backward Classes / Social Welfare, Govt. of Karnataka
scholarships.amount: Fee concession / reimbursement + Vidyasiri food & accommodation stipend (as applicable)
required_documents: Karnataka Domicile & SATS / University Registration ID
scholarships.description: Unified Karnataka post-matric scholarship system providing tuition reimbursement and Vidyasiri maintenance support for SC, ST, OBC, and Minority students.
scholarships.eligibility_notes: Karnataka domicile and valid RD-numbered Caste & Income Certificate required; income cap varies by department/category (typically ₹1–2.5 Lakh for OBC/Minority, up to ₹2.5–10 Lakh slabs for SC/ST fee concessions).
application_steps: Create an SSP Student ID on ssp.postmatric.karnataka.gov.in.
Link your RD Caste & Income certificate and university registration number.
Complete e-Attestation of documents if required and submit.

scholarships.name: Tamil Nadu Pudhumai Penn & First Graduate Technical Tuition Concession
scholarships.provider: Department of Higher Education / Social Welfare, Govt. of Tamil Nadu
scholarships.amount: ₹1,000/month financial assistance (Pudhumai Penn) / Tuition fee waiver (First Graduate)
required_documents: Tamil Nadu Government School Study Certificate (Classes 6–12 for Pudhumai Penn)
First Graduate Certificate (if applying for tuition waiver)
scholarships.description: Tamil Nadu state higher education support programs aiding girl students from government schools and first-generation college graduates pursuing B.Tech/UG degrees.
scholarships.eligibility_notes: Pudhumai Penn targets girl students who studied Classes 6–12 in Tamil Nadu government schools; First Graduate concession requires TNEA counseling + First Graduate certificate.
application_steps: Apply through your Tamil Nadu college nodal office / UMIS portal.
Submit school study certificate or First Graduate certificate for verification.

scholarships.name: Reliance Foundation Undergraduate Scholarship
scholarships.provider: Reliance Foundation
scholarships.amount: Up to ₹2,00,000 over the duration of the undergraduate degree
scholarships.description: National merit-cum-means private scholarship awarding up to ₹2 lakh across the undergraduate degree to 1st-year UG students across all streams including B.Tech.
scholarships.eligibility_notes: Open to 1st-year regular UG students across India with >=60% in Class 12 and household income <= ₹15,00,000 (preference given to income < ₹2,50,000). Mandatory online Aptitude Test required.
application_steps: Register on scholarships.reliancefoundation.org and fill the eligibility questionnaire.
Complete the online application with Class 12 marks and income details.
Appear for the mandatory online Aptitude Test within the scheduled window.
Submit verification documents if shortlisted.

scholarships.name: Foundation For Excellence (FFE) Scholarship for B.E. / B.Tech Students
scholarships.provider: Foundation For Excellence (FFE)
scholarships.amount: ₹50,000 per year (approx. standard grant) + mentorship & employability training
required_documents: JEE / State Engineering Entrance Rank Card & Seat Allotment Letter
scholarships.description: High-impact merit-cum-means private foundation scholarship supporting 1st-year B.E./B.Tech students admitted via national/state entrance ranks with strong academic records and low family income.
scholarships.eligibility_notes: Must be in 1st year B.E./B.Tech (or 5-year Integrated M.Tech) admitted via open merit rank (JEE/state CET) with gross family income typically <= ₹3,00,000/yr.
application_steps: Submit initial eligibility form on ffe.org.
Connect with an assigned FFE Facilitator for document and home/income verification.
Upload marksheets, rank card, fee receipts, and family income proof.

scholarships.name: HDFC Bank Parivartan's ECSS Programme (Undergraduate Professional)
scholarships.provider: HDFC Bank (CSR)
scholarships.amount: Up to ₹75,000 (for professional undergraduate courses)
scholarships.description: CSR scholarship supporting meritorious and underprivileged Indian students pursuing professional UG courses like B.Tech, with special priority for personal/family financial crises.
scholarships.eligibility_notes: Requires >=55% in previous qualifying exam and annual family income <= ₹2,50,000; verify active cycle dates on official HDFC Parivartan / Buddy4Study portal.
application_steps: Visit parivartanecss.com and choose the Undergraduate (Professional) track.
Fill academic, income, and family background details and upload required proofs.
Participate in telephonic verification interview if shortlisted.

scholarships.name: Kotak Kanya Scholarship
scholarships.provider: Kotak Education Foundation
scholarships.amount: Up to ₹1,50,000 per year until graduation
required_documents: Admission Proof at NIRF/NAAC Accredited Reputed Institute
scholarships.description: Merit-cum-means scholarship dedicated to meritorious girl students entering 1st year of professional degrees like B.Tech/Engineering at reputed accredited institutions.
scholarships.eligibility_notes: Restricted to girl students with >=75% in Class 12, family income <= ₹6,00,000, and admission in a NAAC/NIRF-accredited institute.
application_steps: Check accredited institute eligibility on Kotak Education Foundation portal.
Submit Class 12 marks, admission proof, and income certificate.
Complete online assessment/interview rounds if shortlisted.

scholarships.name: ONGC Merit Scholarship Scheme (Engineering)
scholarships.provider: Oil and Natural Gas Corporation (ONGC Foundation)
scholarships.amount: ₹48,000 per annum (₹4,000/month)
scholarships.description: ONGC Foundation merit scholarship supporting 1st-year engineering students across SC, ST, OBC, and General (EWS) categories, with 50% seats reserved for girls.
scholarships.eligibility_notes: Income limit is ₹4,50,000 for SC/ST and ₹2,00,000 for OBC/General-EWS applicants (maximum age 30 years). Confirm category sub-quotas on ongcscholar.org.
application_steps: Apply online at ongcscholar.org during the annual notification window.
Download system-generated form, obtain college certification, and upload signed copy.

scholarships.name: Sitaram Jindal Foundation Scholarship (Engineering & Technical)
scholarships.provider: Sitaram Jindal Foundation
scholarships.amount: Not available (varies by course category and gender; check official scheme table)
scholarships.description: Long-running charitable foundation scholarship assisting needy students in engineering, diploma, and postgraduate courses across India.
scholarships.eligibility_notes: Percentage cutoffs vary slightly by gender and category (typically 60–65% for general boys, relaxed for girls/SC/ST); confirm exact category table on official website.
application_steps: Download the official application form from sitaramjindalfoundation.org.
Get academic and attendance details attested by your Principal/Dean.
Submit application with supporting certificates as instructed by the Trust.

scholarships.name: Central Technical University (IIT/NIT) Merit-cum-Means & Tuition Fee Waiver
scholarships.provider: Central Technical Universities / Institutes of National Importance
scholarships.amount: Full or 2/3rd tuition fee waiver (plus ₹1,000/month pocket allowance in select MCM slabs)
required_documents: Parent ITR / Annual Family Income Certificate
scholarships.description: Representative university-level Merit-cum-Means (MCM) and tuition remission scheme offered by IITs, NITs, and IIITs for B.Tech students based on parental income and CGPA.
scholarships.eligibility_notes: Sample institutional benchmark: exact minimum CGPA (commonly 6.0–7.0), income slabs (<₹1L full waiver, ₹1L–₹5L 2/3rd waiver), and deadlines are set by your specific university's Academic/Scholarship Cell.
application_steps: Log in to your university's ERP / Scholarship portal at the start of the academic semester.
Upload parent income certificate / ITR and latest grade sheet.
Obtain Dean of Student Welfare / Academic verification.

scholarships.name: University Technical Merit Excellence Scholarship (B.Tech CSE / AI&ML)
scholarships.provider: Affiliated State Technical Universities & Engineering Colleges
scholarships.amount: Up to 50% semester tuition concession (varies by university)
scholarships.description: Representative university merit scholarship recognizing high-performing B.Tech students (such as CSE & AI&ML undergraduates) maintaining >=8.0 CGPA.
scholarships.eligibility_notes: Sample institutional template: verify exact CGPA threshold, backlog policy, and tuition concession percentage with your university's scholarship desk.
application_steps: Contact your university's Scholarship / Student Affairs office after semester results.
Submit semester grade sheets, attendance record, and family income proof.
